name: go-lan
description: Self-hosted app to play Go on your local network

scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @go-lan/rules && npm run build -w @go-lan/protocol
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @go-lan/server && npm run build -w @go-lan/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && concurrently -n libs,server,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @go-lan/rules" "npm run dev -w @go-lan/server" "npm run dev -w @go-lan/web"
scripts.test: npm run build:libs && npm run test -w @go-lan/rules && npm run test -w @go-lan/server
